paragraphs.text: The Eastern Sea is body of water bordered by a rocky coast on Shandalar .

It was the location where Bani Bakur , Anthanor , and two other soldiers attacked Tevesh Szat , and where Szat and Leshrac dueled before leaving the plane . It was also the location where Lim-Dûl trapped Kenan Sahrmal , and where Lim-Dûl spirit-leaped into Sahrmal’s body before Bani beheaded Lim-Dûl.
On the shores of the Eastern Sea, an evolved race of slivers inhabits the Skep .
